description: This file defines the Marketing model class for the OpenCart admin report extension. It contains methods to retrieve marketing-related data and total counts from the database, with filtering and pagination capabilities.

classes.name: Marketing
classes.description: A model class for handling marketing report data, including fetching marketing entries and total counts with filtering options.

methods.name: getMarketing
methods.description: Retrieves a list of marketing data entries from the database, applying optional filters such as order status and date range, with support for pagination.

methods.name: getTotalMarketing
methods.description: Returns the total count of marketing records in the database.
